spans.s: 1. मुद् cl. 10. P. मोदयति, to mix, mingle, blend, unite, Dhātup. xxxiii, 66.

2. मुद् cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. ii, 15) मो॑दते (ep. and mc. also P. ˚ति; pf. मुमो॑द, RV.; मुमुदे, MBh. &c.; aor. अमोदिष्ट Gr.; Pot. मुदीमहि, RV.; Prec. मोदिषीष्ठास्, AV.; fut. मोदिता Gr.; मोदिष्यते, MBh.; ind.p. -मोदम्, MBh.),
to be merry or glad or happy, rejoice, delight in (instr. or loc.), RV. &c. &c.:
Caus., मोदयति, ˚ते (aor. अमूमुदत्), to gladden, give pleasure, exhilarate, MBh.; Bhaṭṭ. :
Desid., of Caus. मुमोदयिषति, ŚBr. :
Desid. मुमोदिषते or मुमुदिषते, Pāṇ. i, 2, 26 :
Intens. मोमुद्यते, मोमुदीति, मोमोत्ति Gr.
3. मु॑द् f. joy, delight, gladness, happiness (also pl.), RV. &c. &c.
